entry.title: Agentic AI
entry.content:
A beginner-friendly learning path in TryHackMe providing a strong foundation in computer security. It introduces core concepts in networking, cryptography, and operating systems (Windows, Active Directory, and Linux), while exploring both offensive and defensive security tools. The program also offers insight into real-world applications and career paths in cybersecurity.

entry.title: Blog Introduction
entry.content:
👩🏻‍💻 Welcome to my Cybersecurity Journey


This blog is where I document my path in cybersecurity — from studying core concepts and exploring new tools to reviewing lessons and preparing for certifications.

It’s my way of tracking progress, sharing insights, and building a record of everything I learn as I grow in this field.

Along the way, I’ll also share slices of life outside tech. I love reading, I’m learning how to bake, I’m exploring journaling, and I have a deep love for music. Expect book ratings, baking experiments, travel snapshots, food pics, and a little playlist inspiration sprinkled throughout the blog — a personal touch alongside the cybersecurity content.

Currently, I’m reviewing Cybersecurity 101 with this TryHackMe path. I’m also in a little bit of a side quest at the moment. I’m learning about Agentic AI from huggingface.co!

You can follow my thoughts and progress here on my posts on this blog! 🐳
entry.summary: tracking my journey, past, present, and future — from my first steps in cybersecurity to everyday life, hobbies, and personal growth.
